notes: RULING NEEDED (rule 11, first-person narrative with implicit transmission): «وَ سُئِلَ أَبُو إِبْرَاهِيمَ» names the Imam as the one asked, but the questioner «قُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ» is unnamed; the transmitter of the saying is that unnamed narrator
the Imam is written as the report names him, as the last and only link (owner ruling 2)
